risks.risk: Whether it stitches properly (timing/feed/needle mechanism may be faulty despite looking intact).
risks.proof: Video clip of a full test: thread loaded, bobbin inserted, stitching a straight line on fabric, showing consistent feed and no skipping.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not guaranteed to work (worst case for unverified working condition).

risks.risk: Missing/incorrect accessories (bobbin, needles, presser feet, spool pin, manual parts).
risks.proof: Photo/clip showing all included parts laid out: bobbins, needles, spool holder, presser feet, and any manuals/tools.

risks.risk: Electrical/pedal condition (pedal/cord may be damaged or intermittent).
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the pedal and cord ends + a short clip showing pedal response while the machine is running.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as pedal/electrical function not confirmed.

risks.risk: Condition issues from age (rust, worn feed dogs, bent needle bar, loose knobs).
risks.proof: Close-up photos of: needle area, feed dogs, bobbin case, tension dial, and underside/hinges.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as used with possible wear.

proof_requests: Send a short video of it stitching (threaded) on fabric: straight seam + turning corner, showing consistent feed.
Send close-up photos of the needle area, bobbin compartment, tension dial, and feed dogs.
List and show all accessories included (bobbin(s), needles, spool pin, presser feet, any spare parts).
Show the pedal and cord condition (close-ups) and confirm pedal response in a short clip.
response.reason: The photos identify the machine as an IDEAL TOPSTAR, but there is no decisive proof of working condition, completeness of accessories, or pedal/electrical functionality—so a worst-case price cannot be confidently set from the single image.
